title: Duct penetrations.
officialText:
Ducts that exhaust clothes dryers shall not penetrate or be located within any fireblocking, draftstopping or
any wall, floor/ceiling or other assembly required by the New York City Building Code to be fire-resistance rated, unless such duct is
constructed of galvanized steel or aluminum of the thickness specified in Table 603.4 of the New York City Mechanical Code and the
fire-resistance rating is maintained in accordance with the New York City Building Code. Fire dampers shall not be installed in
clothes dryer exhaust duct systems.
